struct ParsedUrl {
  std::string protocol;     ///< Lowercase scheme, always "http" or "https".
  std::string host;         ///< Host name, never empty.
  std::string apipath;      ///< Api path, or empty when the URL carried none.
  std::optional<int> port;  ///< Set only when the URL named a port explicitly.
}
